row:
Kim Noyce is a Clinical Massage Therapist based in Worthing, West Sussex, offering assessment-led treatment for chronic pain, musculoskeletal injury, post-surgical recovery and stress related conditions.

This channel supports clients with free self care resources including mobility exercises, rehabilitation movement and condition specific tips - so you can continue your recovery at home between appointments.

Conditions include fibromyalgia, chronic fatigue, back pain, sciatica, frozen shoulder, ACJ impingement, hip & knee pain, plantar fasciitis, persistent headaches and post surgical recovery.

Treatment draws on Sports Massage, Remedial Massage, Deep Tissue Massage, CranioSacral Therapy, Advanced Myofascial Release, Trigger Point Therapy and NeuroKinetic Therapy

Offering small group Restorative Movement classes and 1-2-1 sessions in Worthing

Location - Copthorne Hill, Worthing, West Sussex
Website - www.completebalance.co.uk
Email - info@completebalance.co.uk
Call - 07795 550963
